notes.title: UNDER THE ISLAND'S DEMO IS OUT NOW!!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]Hope you are all doing well! Thank you for following along the game's progress. Hot off of participation in some of our showcases last season, we're extremely happy to announce that [b]our demo is out now[/b]! Putting together the demo has been an [b]absolute labor of[/b] [b]love [/b]and we can't wait for everyone to check it out. [/p][p]The demo is a microcosm of the game as a whole, and features not just the opening sequences or introduction, but a (slightly restrained) look at the open nature of Under The Island's world and the many things to do within it. We're extremely excited to share this with everyone and get feedback on the game. [/p][p]You can also join the publisher's Discord to leave feedback and ask questions about the game: [url="https://discord.gg/yy7javF"]https://discord.gg/yy7javF[/url][/p][p]We hope you all enjoy diving into the world of [b]Under The Island![/b][/p]

notes.title: New Trailer Premiered @ Top Hat Studios Publisher Showcase
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We're happy to announce that we're participating in Guerilla Collective this year, as part of our publisher's showcase. While we don't have specific news to share yet, we've put together a brand new trailer for everyone that shows what everyone has to look forward to within the game's world.

[previewyoutube=pvecKYX-0D8;full][/previewyoutube]

We'll have more news to share over the summer about the title! We're extremely excited about how the game is turning out and can't wait to share more information with everyone. In the meantime, you can find more announcements about the publisher showcase and other featured titles over on our publisher's steam page:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/tophatstudios/]https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/tophatstudios/[/url]
